champion.tips: JARVAN IV TIPS AND TRICKS Before using your Ultimate R bait out any dashes or dodge tools first as they will easily escape over it. Don’t let the enemy bully you down in the early game, otherwise, you’ll never be able to engage with your E and Q combo. Poke the enemy down with your E as often as you can. But keep an eye on your mana bar at all times.
champion.builds: THE BEST JARVAN IV BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR SUPPORT IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Jarvan IV Support build, you should take Flash and Ignite as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Electrocute as your keystone, followed by Sudden Impact, Deep Ward and Ultimate Hunter in the primary tree, as well as Triumph and Coup de Grace in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Bloodsong as your first item, followed by Plated Steelcaps and Umbral Glaive. For your last 3 items, you should build Eclipse, Sundered Sky and finish with Serpent's Fang. For the skill order, you want to stick with Q - E - W. Right now, this build has 47.8% winrate over 372 matches played. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Ignite as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Electrocute as your keystone, Sudden Impact, Sixth Sense and Ultimate Hunter in the primary tree, and Triumph with Coup de Grace in the secondary tree, as well as Attack Speed, Adaptive Force, and Health Scaling as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Celestial Opposition as your first item, then Plated Steelcaps as a second item and Umbral Glaive as a third item. You want to finish the build with Sundered Sky, Thornmail and Vigilant Wardstone. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it Q - E - W. This build is currently sitting at a 50.0% win rate across 188 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta Jarvan IV Support build in the current patch, try Flash and Ignite as your Summoner Spells, Hail of Blades, Sudden Impact, Deep Ward and Ultimate Hunter as your primary rune tree, and Legend: Haste with Coup de Grace as your secondary tree. Use Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force and Health as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Bloodsong as your first item, then finish Ionian Boots of Lucidity as your second item, and Umbral Glaive as third item. The last 3 options are Edge of Night, Guardian Angel and Serpent's Fang. The ability order for this build is Q - E - W. As of the current patch, this build has a 52.8% win rate over 123 matches played. Situational Jarvan IV Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Jarvan IV build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Jarvan IV runes page.
